title: Dubai Developers Confirm On-Time Project Deliveries Despite Ongoing Regional Conflict
summary_ru: 📰 Dubai Developers Confirm On-Time Project Deliveries Despite Ongoing Regional Conflict Dubai’s leading real estate developers have reaffirmed their commitment to delivering projects on schedule despite ongoing regional geopolitical tensions, highlighting the continued strength and stability of the emirate’s property sector. Azizi Developments reported Dh2 billion in sales during its Ramadan campaign, reflecting sustained investor appetite and strong end-user demand across residential offerings. Group CEO Farhad Azizi emphasized that Dubai’s real estate market continues to demonstrate global resilience, supported by long-term planning and a stable operating environment—even during regional uncertainties. #Дубай #ОАЭ #Новости
